justification: Existing `electors` concept (persons, ac/pc/state) covers total enrolled voters per entity. This ingest adds the publisher-provided sex breakdown (male / female / third_gender) as a FACET on the existing concept per ADR-0044 (same noun + unit + grain = facet, not new mint). TN CEO publishes this disaggregation before each AE cycle. The variable_id deliberately omits the `ac-` prefix — same indicator identity surfaces at state-aggregate and pc-aggregate grains once future ingests land them (Max OWID identity test).
source_producer: Office of the Chief Electoral Officer, Tamil Nadu
source_title: Tamil Nadu Electoral Roll - AC-wise Electors by Sex
